latestVersion.changelog:
Green Screen Editor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create and manage sessions for AI-powered video background removal and replacement.
- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) for automated green screen processing.
- Simple prompt-based workflow — describe your desired background and export 1080p MP4 results.
- Integrated cloud rendering pipeline with user feedback during processing and error handling.
- Session-based state, credits management, and support for batch or iterative editing.
- Supports direct user prompts for export, credits, status, and uploads with concise feedback.
